class K extends BWebServlet {
  void a(String s) {
    try {
      Double.parseDouble(s);
    } catch (NumberFormatException e) {
      return;
    }
  }
  void b(String s) {
    try { Double.valueOf(s); }

    // nothing
    catch (Exception e)
    {
      op.getResponse().setStatus(400);
    }
  }

    try { Integer.parseInt(s); }
    a(); b(); c(); d();
    catch (Exception e) { }
  }

    try {
      try { Long.parseLong(s); }
      catch (Exception e) { x = 4000; }

    catch (Exception e) { y = "400"; }

    catch(Exception e) { rsp.sendError(SC_BAD_REQUEST); }
